reference_urls.used_for: Section order and structure only. The owl template already encodes it; no re-scrape was needed and none of Owl's brand program names are used.

brand_source: Client logo pixel sampling (primary) + client homepage stylesheet (corroborating). See intake-scraped.json → brand.colors._source.

contrast_audit.method: WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance ratio, computed rather than eyeballed.

results.verdict: FAIL — which is why --color-on-accent is the dark ink, not white

contrast_audit.note: The gold is a light colour, so unlike the template default it cannot carry white button text. --color-on-accent is therefore the near-navy ink. The three-token accent split (fill / ink / on-dark) is preserved as the template requires.

typography.rationale: The client's site loads Open Sans + Roboto, and its theme also references Poppins/Archivo Black. None is a deliberate brand choice — they are theme defaults. Per the design-reference fallback rule the owl template's own stack is kept.

spacing_motion: Inherited unchanged from the owl template. Nothing was taken from the client's existing site — see the anti-pattern lock in intake-from-web.
anti_patterns_merged: purple / indigo / violet accents (unless explicitly requested)
generic construction stock photo (handshake, diverse team in hardhats, generic hard-hat closeup)
Lucide icon rows (max 1 outline icon per section, semantic only)
"Trusted by 10,000+ customers" without a real number from GBP
randomized section order — always use the fixed order from the template

anti_pattern_exceptions.exception: --color-primary #2d317c is a deep indigo-navy. It is not an aesthetic pick: it is the dominant colour of the client's own logo, measured at 777,237 pixels of the wordmark. The rule exists to stop generic AI-purple creeping in; a brand-derived navy is the case it was never meant to catch.

anti_pattern_exceptions.rule: "Trusted by N+ customers" without a real number
anti_pattern_exceptions.compliance: No rating, review count, customer count, or years-in-business figure appears anywhere on the generated site. None could be independently corroborated, so none is asserted — and no aggregateRating is emitted in JSON-LD.

imagery_policy: Every photograph on the generated site is the client's own, downloaded from their WordPress uploads and served from /img/ rather than hotlinked. No stock photography is used. Service-area landmark photos are the only exception and carry explicit CC attribution where required.

_notes.cost_note: No reference URLs were re-scraped — the owl template already encodes the primary reference's structure, and brand tokens came from the logo file already downloaded during intake.
